title: IndicatorDataset
description: v1 — the leading-indicator dataset the oracle shapes and the airlock writes to the sandbox. This is also the payload the main-server orchestrator pulls after accepting a broadcast. Data only (values + provenance); no forecast or judgment — the orchestrator does the forecasting.

datasetId.description: ds-<uuid v4>. Stable id for this stored dataset; referenced by the availability broadcast and used by the orchestrator to pull.

referenceMonth.description: YYYY-MM the indicators inform (the forecast month being boosted).

target.description: Which forecast target these indicators feed.

source.description: The provider this wake fetched from. One source per scheduled wake (per-source release calendar).

releaseDate.description: The source's official release date for this reference month.

asOf.description: When the airlock assembled this dataset (RFC 3339).

targetId.description: Forecast targets (Census M3 EITS). Extend deliberately.

source.description: Free / keyed providers only in v1. Paywalled sentiment (ISM, S&P Global) intentionally excluded.

seriesId.description: Closed enum of series. Targets double as indicators (new orders lead shipments). Paywalled series (ism_pmi, sp_global_pmi) excluded in v1.

leadTimeMonths.description: Approximate lead over the target, in months (0 = coincident).

unit.description: Reported unit, verbatim from the source (e.g. 'Millions of Dollars', 'Index', 'Percent').

value.description: The airlock applies tighter per-series range checks before storing.

isPreliminary.description: True for advance/flash vintages subject to later revision.

sourceHost.description: Host actually contacted, e.g. 'api.stlouisfed.org' — must be on the airlock host allowlist.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the raw source response, for dedupe and audit.
